title: [Feature Request] Customizable prompt and output colors
body: While we are able to change the theme for Claude in terminal, I have a suggestion to add further customizations. During long sessions, it is hard to distinguish user's input vs output provided. Please see screenshots: Maybe it can be nested here in `/config` - User prompt styling: foreground/background color, prepending symbol Thank you for consideration!
author: lanadz

top_comments.author: davek-ai
top_comments.body:
Agreed. 

A slight improvement might be to add a bit more styling to the '>'.

top_comments.author: salavatkhafizov
top_comments.body: If customization is long way to go, at least I would suggest highlighting user message with some color, such as Yellow.

top_comments.author: bl-ue
top_comments.body: [`tweakcc`](https://github.com/Piebald-AI/tweakcc) can customize your Claude Code themes.  A feature to customize the user input in the history is a great idea!
